## About
City Car Radio and Air is a car audio shop on Second Street in San Rafael. We handle sales, repairs and installation for car stereos, speakers, subwoofers and CarPlay units, along with security systems, window tinting and auto detailing.
Customers tell us they value the time Juan and the team take to walk through their options and explain how a system goes in. We are rated 4.8 on Google from 115 reviews. Hablamos español.

## Services
- Sales, repairs and installation: Head units, speakers and subwoofers from Alpine, Pioneer and JL Audio, with other brands available.
- CarPlay installed: A reviewer had CarPlay installed in their Hummer.
- Radio replacement integration: Swapping out a factory radio, with dash kits and harnesses so the new unit fits.
- Window tinting: Window tint for your car.
- Parrot Bluetooth car kit: The Parrot Bluetooth car kit, available in the shop.
- Escort radar/laser defense systems: Escort radar and laser defense systems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take insurance work?
A: Yes. Insurance work is welcome here.

Q: Do you offer easy finance?
A: Yes, through Snap. It is open to people with good, bad or no credit.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at 820 Second Street in San Rafael, just before Lincoln.

Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: Monday through Friday we are open 6:30 am to 5:00 pm. We are closed Sunday. Call ahead for Saturday hours.
